protobuf_byte_policy.payload_hash: SHA-256 over exact immutable payload bytes

identity_profiles.EventId: strongly-typed UUIDv7, full 128 bits, global, immutable, never reused
identity_profiles.OperationId: strongly-typed UUIDv7 for one independently durable logical operation
identity_profiles.TransactionId: strongly-typed UUIDv7 inside TransactionEventRef for one logical atomic durable mutation transaction
identity_profiles.CorrelationId: strongly-typed UUIDv7 for one trusted bounded correlation context
identity_profiles.CausationRef: typed reference to EventId, CommandRef, OperationId or TransactionId; no standalone causation UUID
identity_profiles.AnalyticsActorId: strongly-typed UUIDv7 scoped by analytics identity domain and identity epoch; a new epoch requires a fresh pseudonym for the same operational actor
identity_profiles.RuntimeOrderRef: scope ownership generation + RuntimeExecutionOrdinal; requires concrete WorldId+ChannelId or WorldId+InstanceId scope

retention_profiles.purpose: Prove and reconcile authoritative Character owner, world, and lifecycle mutations and support bounded security, operations, and administrative investigation.
retention_profiles.finite_retention_duration_or_ceiling: P90D rolling ordinary ceiling from authoritative event timestamp/commit
retention_profiles.export_redaction_policy: Case-scoped authorized export redacts unrelated player-linked fields.
retention_profiles.deletion_or_anonymization_policy: Delete the retained player-linked event, envelope, and payload at ordinary expiry; do not convert it into an indefinite pseudonymous analytics record.
retention_profiles.legal_hold_policy: Explicit case/legal authorization must record reason, authorizing actor, start time, affected records or scope, and audited access; release returns the record to ordinary expiry and deletion.

retention_profiles.purpose: Prove and reconcile the first closed DUR-03 one-item MINT/TRANSFER transactions and support bounded DUR-03 operations, support and security investigation; no economy, market, trade, public history, balancing, detector or AI-use purpose.
retention_profiles.finite_retention_duration_or_ceiling: P90D = 7,776,000 elapsed seconds from the immutable trusted-server timestamp in the event's ANL envelope; lifetime [start, expiry), never recomputed or refreshed
retention_profiles.export_redaction_policy: Case-scoped audited export redacts unrelated player-linked envelope and payload fields; export does not extend retention or create an indefinite investigative copy.
retention_profiles.deletion_or_anonymization_policy: Delete the retained player-linked event envelope and payload at ordinary expiry; do not replace deletion with indefinite anonymized or pseudonymous retention. Expiry never weakens receipt/source-cause replay protection or ItemInstance non-reuse evidence.
retention_profiles.legal_hold_policy: Explicit case/legal authorization must record reason, authorizing actor, start time and exact affected records or scope, with audited placement, access, scope change and release; release returns to the original expiry without resetting the clock.
